description.value:
Takes no Attachment Slot and fits Exotic Weapons. Install one at a time. It changes the Range Table the weapon fires on and nothing else. Pistols: Snub Barrel → Snubnose Pistol, Long Barrel → Long Barrel Pistol. SMGs/Heavy SMGs: Short Barrel → Subcompact SMG. Shotguns: Short Barrel → Short Barrel Shotgun, Choke → Long Barrel Shotgun. Assault Rifles: Carbine / Battle / Marksman Barrel → that table. Sniper Rifles: Scout Barrel → Scout Rifle, Long Barrel → Anti-materiel Rifle. Bows/Crossbows: Short Limbs → Shortbow, Long Limbs → Longbow. Launchers: Short Tube → Grenade Launcher, Standard Tube → Rocket Launcher, Long Tube → Missile Launcher.

Cost: 100eb
